title: Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Risk Aversion in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.02755v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training AIs to be risk-averse in resources could offer a failsafe in the event that AIs turn out misaligned. Misaligned but risk-averse AIs would tend to prefer low-risk, low-reward strategies like cooperation over high-risk, high-reward strategies like rebellion, limiting the downsides of any misalignment. But we can only feasibly train AIs to be risk-averse on low-stakes gambles, and we will only be safe if their risk aversion generalizes to astronomically-high-stakes gambles. Will it? To shed light on this question, we introduce RiskAverseOOD: a benchmark for measuring how well risk aversion generalizes out of distribution. We then offer some initial results. Using a variety of methods to make Qwen3-8B choose risk-aversely when the stakes are low, we find that we can induce substantial risk aversion when the stakes are astronomically high. translated_title: 语言模型风险厌恶的分布外泛化
translated_abstract: 训练人工智能在资源方面表现出风险厌恶，可以在AI出现不对齐（misaligned）的情况下提供一种安全保障。不对齐但风险厌恶的AI会倾向于选择低风险、低回报的策略（如合作），而非高风险、高回报的策略（如反叛），从而限制任何不对齐可能带来的负面影响。但我们只能在低风险赌局中可行地训练AI的风险厌恶，而只有当这种风险厌恶能够泛化到天文数字级高风险赌局时，我们才是安全的。它会泛化吗？为了阐明这个问题，我们引入了RiskAverseOOD：一个用于衡量风险厌恶分布外泛化能力的基准。随后我们提供了一些初步结果。使用多种方法使Qwen3-8B在低风险情况下做出风险厌恶的选择，我们发现当风险达到天文数字级别时，我们能够诱导出显著的风险厌恶。从选择安全的“合作”选项的基线比率2%，我们观察到比率提升至约70%（SFT...
tldr: 该论文提出RiskAverseOOD基准，并发现在低风险赌局上训练出的Qwen3-8B风险厌恶能够有效泛化到天文数字级高风险情境，将选择安全“合作”选项的比率从2%提升至约70%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RiskAverseOOD, a benchmark demonstrating that risk aversion trained on low-stakes gambles in Qwen3-8B generalizes to astronomically-high-stakes scenarios, raising the rate of choosing a safe 'Cooperate' option from a 2% baseline to around 70%.
